narrative.overview:
**North star: The Clear Ledger.**

maney is a desktop-first financial workspace using Geist foundations. Surfaces are strictly white and neutral light gray, with black/gray typography. Lime green is the only interface accent, reserved for primary actions, the active navigation item, and important overdue notices. Broad financial cards and page backgrounds stay neutral.

The user-supplied maney logo novo.png is the wordmark, and favicon.png is the compact mark and source of the browser/app icons. Preserve the artwork and its proportions. The gradient inside this supplied artwork is not a general UI treatment.

Page subtitles and the company switcher remain removed. The overview uses equal upcoming-payable and upcoming-receivable panels, with overdue accounts below. Local records and layout preference keep their existing storage identifiers so the rebrand preserves data. The latest overview uses a lime available-balance card, dark upcoming-panel headers, an emphasized overdue reminder and no separate overdue table. ReactFrame Sidebar source provides the navigation. A shared custom date-range popover filters financial views, while current-week due dates use weekday names.
keyCharacteristics: Only lime green for relevant interface highlights.
Clear financial labels, icons and tabular values.
Responsive, collapsible navigation and context-preserving sheets.
Adapted ReactFrame sidebar with controlled rail, tooltips and keyboard navigation.
Inclusive custom date ranges shared by financial views.
Canvas-gray top bar shares the centered 1600px content container and responsive gutters.

rules.name: Relevant Highlights
rules.body: Reserve lime for primary actions, active selection and important notices; all financial surfaces and values stay neutral.

dos: Keep white/gray surfaces and explicit financial status labels.
donts: Do not use other accent colors or pale green page backgrounds.
Do not color every card or replace the supplied logo.
